provided.name: ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant
provided.rule: If current Contract Product Line is incompatible with the new resolved Customer, append classification invalidation in the caller LLD-03 UnitOfWork; never silently choose a replacement Contract Product Line.

provided.name: SlaOverviewProjectionProvider
provided.rule: Unknown/unclassified/cohort-incomplete states remain explicit; Objective timezone has no SLA chronology authority.

consumed.name: DurableJobCoordinator
consumed.transaction: caller LLD-06 CancelSlaReportAttempt UnitOfWork; Foundation inserts no command receipt and never commits independently
consumed.rule: LLD-06 uses the exact sla_report_job_refs job identity and SLA_REPORT_GENERATION_V1 contract version; cancellation of the technical job and cancellation of the report attempt commit or roll back together.

rules: LLD-06 never parses raw source workbooks and never mutates SR lifecycle/Customer source facts.
Known SLA/application instants are canonical UTC whole seconds; ordinary and cohort calendar interpretation uses America/Guayaquil.
ReportJobCoordinator is an LLD-06-local semantic facade over the exact LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator contract and owns no competing durable-job state.
